title: Depth-one gates have only literal children
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables of the form $g(c_1,\dots,c_k)$, a single gate $g$ (either AND or OR) applied to a list of child circuits $c_1,\dots,c_k$. If the depth of $C$ is at most $1$, then every child $c_i$ is a literal, that is, $c_i = \ell_i$ for some literal $\ell_i$ (a variable index together with a polarity).
hypotheses_covered: C is a gate node applied to a list of children (with gate type AND or OR)
the depth of the node is at most 1
replaced:
If a gate node $\mathrm{node}\,\mathit{isAnd}\,cs$ has depth at most $1$, then every child
$c\in cs$ is a literal, i.e.\ $c = \mathrm{lit}\,l$ for some literal $l$.
